title: Word autokey: each word is enciphered with the previous word (or the word two back) as key, plain or cipher letters, forwards or reversed, wrap or run-on, on 666,993 keyword tableaux, on any tableau, and on one hidden alphabet
k4_result: Keyword tableaux: 0 of 128.4 billion settings pass (666,993 alphabets x 5 layouts x Vigenere/Beaufort x fed letter numbered on the plain or cipher side x sign x 5,348 word-split tests, 7+ exact checks). On the eight full plain-feed tests (14 known key letters) the most pairs that ever agree is 8 of 14 (21 settings; 1,121 at 7). Cipher feed, first 1,000 alphabets: at most 11 of 24 pairs agree. Any tableau with distinct rows and columns: EAST|NORTH|EAST with the previous plaintext word read forwards is impossible outright (plain T under key T gives R at letter 28 and S at letter 33). One hidden alphabet (21,392 systems): all 12,624 cipher-feed systems with all 24 clue letters are impossible; of the 32 full plain-feed systems 31 are impossible and 1 (EAST|NORTH|EAST, key word reversed, run-on, C = K - P) has solutions; over all systems with 14+ pairs 17 list a solution and 218 are not decidable.
controls: 5 shuffled K4s, each on a different fifth of the alphabets (one full pass together): 0 settings pass; most pairs agreeing 9 of 14 (1 setting), 50 at 8, 1,363 at 7 (K4: none at 9, 21 at 8, 1,121 at 7). Cipher feed on the same 1,000 alphabets: 11 of 24 for every control. Hidden alphabet, systems with 14+ pairs that list a solution: 77, 37, 19, 31, 47 (K4: 17); full plain-feed systems with solutions: 3, 1, 0, 0, 0 (K4: 1). K4 is at or below the controls everywhere.
planted: 7/7. Five on random dictionary tableaux hidden among 9,000 others: previous plaintext word forwards/wrap (13 checks), reversed/run-on with EAST|NORTHEAST (16), previous cipher word (23), cipher word two back (13), plaintext run-on (15); letters 34-96 read back 61-63 of 63, English -4.39 to -4.49. Two on random hidden alphabets: cipher feed with 24 pairs, true alphabet recovered (22 letters placed); plain feed with 14 pairs, kept but not pinned down (too few equations).
scope_limits: Clue words split only as EAST|NORTH|EAST, EAST|NORTHEAST, EASTNORTH|EAST, EASTNORTHEAST and BERLIN|CLOCK, BERLINCLOCK; clue positions exact. Key word = previous word or word two back only; the same rule in both clues. Word two back with plain feed is NOT decidable (4 known pairs). Unknown word in front of each clue: lengths 1-12. Tableaux: A-Z, KRYPTOS, dictionary keyword alphabets and their two transposition-mixed forms; key = constant + or - the fed letter (no multiplier, no extra repeating word on top). Hidden alphabet: one alphabet on all three sides only; systems with 6+ free dimensions are not decided (K4: 12 plain-feed and 206 cipher-feed systems with 14+ pairs, all with partial clue use), and the 17 K4 systems that have solutions leave the alphabet too loose to decrypt anything, so they are neither confirmed nor excluded (controls have more of them). No transposition before or after. Controls saw a fifth of the alphabets each. Agreement count for cipher feed only on the first 1,000 alphabets (the exact pass test covered all).

negative.family: Word autokey (each word keys the next)
negative.hypothesis: After a primer word, every K4 plaintext word is enciphered with the word before it as the key, so EAST keys NORTH, NORTH keys EAST and BERLIN keys CLOCK.
negative.scope: Exact test on the clue letters, 7+ checks. Splits EAST|NORTH|EAST, EAST|NORTHEAST, EASTNORTH|EAST, EASTNORTHEAST x BERLIN|CLOCK, BERLINCLOCK; key word = previous word or word two back, forwards or reversed, plaintext or cipher letters, wrap or run-on; word in front of each clue 1-12 letters; 666,993 alphabets (A-Z, KRYPTOS, dictionary keyword and two transposition-mixed forms) x 5 layouts x Vigenere/Beaufort x fed letter on plain or cipher side x added or subtracted: 128.4 billion settings. Plus any-tableau clash test and one hidden alphabet on all sides (21,392 linear systems, distinct positions required).
negative.outcome: Dead in scope: 0 of 128.4 billion settings pass; most agreement on the 14 known key letters is 8 of 14 against 9 of 14 for shuffled K4s (0 passes in the controls; planted 7/7). EAST|NORTH|EAST with the previous plaintext word forwards is impossible on any tableau (T under T gives both R and S). Hidden alphabet: every system using all 24 clue letters is impossible; 17 looser systems have solutions and 218 are undecided, no more than in shuffled K4s (19-77 with solutions). Not decided: word two back with plain feed, other word splits.

follow_ups: The any-tableau clash test (same plain and key letter must give the same cipher letter; same key and cipher letter the same plain letter) costs nothing and needs no alphabet. Run it as a pre-check on every earlier model whose key letters inside the clues are known or fed (fixed-lag autokeys 1-12, idea 74's lag patterns, idea 90's row lags): it rules out ALL tableaux at once, including hidden ones, where a clash exists.

Word autokey where the key word is not the neighbour but a fixed word of the sentence (for example every word keyed by the FIRST word of its sentence, or by the last word of the previous sentence): inside the clues this is a repeating key restarted at word starts, testable with period 3-12 and restart points at 21/25/30 and 63/69.
